info.name: YouTube Liquid Glass UI — [BETA]
info.description:
YOUTUBE LIQUID GLASS UI - PREMIUM REVAMP (YT + YT MUSIC)
A high-performance, GPU-accelerated liquid glass overhaul engineered for native grid stability and 60fps responsiveness.

CORE FEATURES:
- Refractive Liquid Glass: 18px multi-stop prism gradients with specular upper-edge lighting.
- Optical Parallax Hovers: Inner thumbnail lens zoom + light sweep (zero text blur or layout shift).
- Full UI Coverage: Home, Shorts, Watch History, Search Suggestions, Side Drawers, Miniplayer, and YT Music.
- Native Grid Lock: Preserves exact 1x4 Video and 1x6 Shorts layouts + Theater/Fullscreen edge detection.

NOT FOR / DO NOT USE IF:
- Light Mode Users: Strictly engineered for YouTube Dark Theme (Appearance > Dark theme).
- Hardware Acceleration OFF: Requires Browser Hardware Acceleration enabled for smooth real-time backdrop blurs.
- Stacked Themes: Disable other YouTube visual/grid CSS styles to prevent double borders and layout collisions.
info.additionalInfo: Note: This project is currently in Beta. Visual tokens, animations, and layout fixes are updated frequently. Expect rapid changes and minor edge-case bugs while we fine-tune full coverage across YouTube and YT Music.
